findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_service_details, resolve_endpoint, what_agents_are_asking_for · Private data: find_paid_service, get_service_details, resolve_endpoint, what_agents_are_asking_for · Public sink: get_service_details, what_agents_are_asking_for · Destructive: find_paid_service.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_service_details, resolve_endpoint, what_agents_are_asking_for · Private data: find_paid_service, get_service_details, resolve_endpoint, what_agents_are_asking_for · Public sink: get_service_details, what_agents_are_asking_for · Destructive: find_paid_service

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
